g.text: Source: Copernicus EMS, EFAS, GHS-OBAT, GHS-POP 2020 (challenge data); OpenStreetMap. Team analysis. Residents are an order of magnitude. Municipalities: GISCO LAU 2021. Shelters are candidates, not official (1.5 km walk, 4 m² per person). Counts rounded to 10.
